**Subject:** 1:1 to Discuss Recent Performance and Support

Hi Alex,

I’d like to schedule a 1:1 with you this week to talk about some recent changes I’ve noticed in your work. I want to be upfront about the purpose of the meeting so you have time to prepare and aren’t caught off guard.

Over the past quarter, I’ve seen a few areas where your performance hasn’t matched your usual high standards. Specifically, the Persona V3 integration shipped 13 days late, and the evaluation pipeline project is still incomplete past its April 1 deadline. I’ve also heard from the team that your code reviews have become less thorough—several complex PRs received only brief “LGTM” comments. Additionally, you missed two team standups without notice and were unresponsive on Teams for several hours on multiple occasions.

I know this isn’t typical for you. Last year, you led the Persona V2 launch, mentored junior engineers, and consistently exceeded expectations. That’s why I want to check in and understand if something has changed or if there’s anything I can do to help.

In our meeting, I’d like to discuss what’s been going on from your perspective, any challenges you’re facing, and how we can work together to get things back on track. My goal is to support you and make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Please let me know your availability for a 1:1 this week. If you’d like to talk sooner, I’m happy to make time.

Thanks,  
[Your Name]
